public static final class LevelResolver.Builder extends LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder<LevelResolver.Builder>
Level resolver builder. LevelResolver.LevelConfig that are added have higher precedence.

  • Method Details

    • build

      public LogProvider<LevelResolver> build()
      Builds a level resolver combining LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.config(LevelConfig), LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.level(Level, String), and resolver(LevelResolver) into a single resolver of equal priority (the highest severity/most restrictive level found for a logger name wins), and, if any fallbacks were added, wrapping that in a priority chain where the fallbacks are only consulted for logger names the combined resolver above has no opinion on (resolves to System.Logger.Level.ALL). The result is cached - deferred as a LogProvider (rather than building the cached resolver directly) since the cache also needs LogConfig.alerts() to report a logger name whose level property fails to resolve, and only a couple of resolver primitives (this builder's cache, and separately the global resolver's own alerting wrapper) need alerts at all - not every LevelResolver/LevelResolver.LevelConfig implementation.
      Returns:
      level resolver provider.

    • resolver

      public LevelResolver.Builder resolver(LevelResolver resolver)
      Adds a level resolver to the end of the resolve list. Resolvers added this way are combined with equal priority: for a given logger name the most restrictive level found across all of them (including LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.config(LevelConfig) / LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.level(Level, String)) wins.
      Parameters:
      resolver - level resolver.
      Returns:
      this

    • fallback

      public LevelResolver.Builder fallback(LevelResolver resolver)
      Adds a lower priority fallback level resolver. Fallbacks are tried in the order added and only consulted for a logger name if every resolver ahead of it (everything from LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.config(LevelConfig), LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.level(Level, String), resolver(LevelResolver), and any earlier added fallback) has no opinion for that name, i.e. resolves to System.Logger.Level.ALL. This is useful for e.g. giving a route's own level configuration priority over a global level resolver without a more specific match in the global resolver being able to win.
      Parameters:
      resolver - fallback level resolver.
      Returns:
      this
